retiredScope: Only the unused extracted partial node_modules from the interrupted installation
verification: Source inventory records regular-file bytes and SHA-256, modes, symlink targets, internal hardlink membership and observed outside-tree alias counts.
Source stat identities and content were compared before and after archive creation, then again immediately before retirement.
Every archive entry was replayed and matched against source content, modes, symlinks and internal hardlink membership before retirement.
The archive and private inventory remain retained for recovery; original source, manifests, isolated configurations, failed-install logs, manager cache and shared package store remain retained.
limitations: Dependency-byte preservation does not establish a completed installation, baseline, independent fault or comparative qualification.
Recovery preserves the internal archive hardlink graph; outside-tree aliases were recorded and not removed, rather than recreated by extraction.
This is a content/mode/link recovery check, not an ACL, extended-attribute or security-containment claim.
